summary: Fugro is dutch multinational corporation, founded in 1962. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 13 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about acquisitions; 3 about growth or hiring.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Dutch geo-data specialist surveying the earth and seabed; 14 roles at its Nootdorp office, all in English, mostly senior tech and project roles.

culture.text: Staff often studied geology, civil, electrical or mechanical engineering, at TU Delft, Plymouth, Robert Gordon or Utrecht.
Is building a cloud data platform on Databricks as part of a digital transformation.

open.text: Fugro N.V., Fugro Innovation & Technology B.V. and Fugro Marine Services B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.

growth.text: Won a major marine asset integrity contract in Australia.
Secured more survey work for pipeline projects off Timor-Leste.
Completed an ultra-deepwater survey with an autonomous underwater vehicle for Petronas.

worth_knowing.text: Publishes a trading update on 30 October.
